paragraphs: UnitedHealth Group Incorporated is an American multinational company based in Eden Prairie, Minnesota, specializing in health insurance and health care services. Selling insurance products under UnitedHealthcare, and health care services under the Optum brand, it is the world's ninth-largest company by revenue and the largest health care company by revenue. The company is ranked fourth on the 2026 Fortune Global 500.

UnitedHealth Group had a market capitalization of more than $300 billion as of year-end 2025. The company is the largest health insurer in the United States, insuring over 50 million people, and operates globally.

UnitedHealth Group has faced numerous investigations, lawsuits, and fines, including SEC enforcement for stock option backdating, Medicare over-billing, unfair claims practices, mental health treatment denials, and anticompetitive behavior.

people.name: Stephen Hemsley
people.title: Chair and Chief Executive Officer
people.bio: Has served as Chief Executive Officer and Chair since May 2025 and has been a board member since 2000. Previously served as Chief Executive Officer from November 2006 to August 2017 and subsequently as Executive Chair and Non-Executive Chair.
people.quote: Stephen Hemsley has served as Chief Executive Officer and Chair of the Board of UnitedHealth Group since May 2025.

people.name: Wayne DeVeydt
people.title: Chief Financial Officer
people.bio: Has served as Chief Financial Officer since September 2025. Previously served as Managing Director of Bain Capital, Chief Executive Officer and Executive Chairman of Surgery Partners, and Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of Elevance Health.
people.quote: Wayne DeVeydt has served as Chief Financial Officer of UnitedHealth Group since September 2025.

people.name: Erin McSweeney
people.title: Executive Vice President and Chief People Officer
people.bio: Has served as Executive Vice President and Chief People Officer since March 2022. Previously served as chief of staff to UnitedHealth Group's Office of the Chief Executive and as Executive Vice President and Chief Human Resources Officer at Optum.
people.quote: Erin McSweeney has served as Executive Vice President and Chief People Officer of UnitedHealth Group since March 2022.

people.name: Timothy Noel
people.title: Chief Executive Officer, UnitedHealthcare
people.bio: Has served as Chief Executive Officer of UnitedHealthcare since January 2025. Previously served as Chief Executive Officer of UnitedHealthcare's Medicare & Retirement business and as Chief Financial Officer and Senior Vice President of federal products for Medicare & Retirement.
people.quote: Tim Noel has served as Chief Executive Officer of UnitedHealthcare since January 2025.

people.name: Thomas Roos
people.title: Senior Vice President and Chief Accounting Officer
people.bio: Has served as Senior Vice President and Chief Accounting Officer since August 2015. Previously was a Partner at Deloitte & Touche LLP.
people.quote: Tom Roos has served as Senior Vice President and Chief Accounting Officer of UnitedHealth Group since August 2015.

people.name: Christopher Zaetta
people.title: Executive Vice President and Chief Legal Officer and Corporate Secretary
people.bio: Has served as Executive Vice President, Chief Legal Officer and Corporate Secretary since May 2024, following service as Optum's Chief Legal Officer from September 2020. Previously held leadership roles at UnitedHealth Group from May 2011 to September 2019 and was a Vice President at Johnson & Johnson before joining Optum in 2020.
people.quote: Chris Zaetta has served as Executive Vice President, Chief Legal Officer and Corporate Secretary of UnitedHealth Group since May 2024.

people.name: Charles Baker
people.title: Director
people.bio: President of the National Collegiate Athletic Association since 2023. Previously served as Governor of Massachusetts from 2015 to 2023 and CEO of Harvard Pilgrim Health Care from 1999 to 2009.
people.quote: Charles Baker has extensive public sector and health care leadership experience

people.name: Timothy Flynn
people.title: Director
people.bio: Served at KPMG from 1979 to 2011, including as Chairman of KPMG International from 2007 to 2011 and CEO of KPMG LLP from 2005 to 2008.
people.quote: Timothy Flynn has expertise in financial reporting, audit and enterprise risk management

people.name: Paul Garcia
people.title: Director
people.bio: Served as Chairman and CEO of Global Payments Inc. from 1999 to 2014. Previously served as President and CEO of NaBanco from 1982 to 1995.
people.quote: Paul Garcia brings to the Board significant executive leadership and technological expertise

people.name: Kristen Gil
people.title: Director
people.bio: Served at Alphabet from 2007 to 2024, including as Vice President, Business Finance Officer from 2018 to 2023. Previously held roles at Marketron International and McKinsey & Company.
people.quote: Kristen Gil has extensive strategic, operational and financial leadership experience developed during her tenure at Alphabet Inc.

people.name: Scott Gottlieb, M.D.
people.title: Director
people.bio: Served as Commissioner of the U.S. Food and Drug Administration from 2017 to 2019. Has served as Senior Fellow at the American Enterprise Institute and Special Partner at New Enterprise Associates since 2019.
people.quote: Dr. Scott Gottlieb has extensive clinical, regulatory and health care expertise

people.name: Stephen Hemsley
people.title: Chair of the Board
people.bio: Joined UnitedHealth Group in 1997 and has served as Chair and CEO since 2025, following earlier service as COO, President, CEO, Executive Chair and Non-Executive Chair. Previously served as Managing Partner and CFO at Arthur Andersen.
people.quote: Stephen Hemsley brings to the Board vast company and health care institutional knowledge

people.name: F. William McNabb III
people.title: Lead Independent Director
people.bio: Served at The Vanguard Group from 1986 to 2018, including as CEO from 2008 to 2017 and Chairman from 2008 to 2018. Elected UnitedHealth Group's Lead Independent Director in August 2025.
people.quote: F. William McNabb III brings to the Board extensive global financial expertise

people.name: Valerie Montgomery Rice, M.D.
people.title: Director
people.bio: President and CEO of Morehouse School of Medicine. Her experience includes clinical, academic, management and public health leadership.
people.quote: Dr. Valerie Montgomery Rice has significant clinical, academic, management and public health leadership experience

people.name: John Noseworthy, M.D.
people.title: Director
people.bio: Former CEO and President of Mayo Clinic. Committee memberships are not stated in the provided text.
people.quote: John Noseworthy, M.D. are each independent under the NYSE rules and the Company's Standards for Director Independence.
